mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, created_by, export_mode, task_ids_json, country_iso2s_json, request_hash, status, snapshot_at, lease_until, claim_token, attempt_count, storage_key, file_name, content_type, file_size, detail_row_count, error_message, created_at, updated_at, finished_at, expires_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_task_export_job (tenant_id, created_by, export_mode, task_ids_json, country_iso2s_json, request_hash, status, snapshot_at, attempt_count, summary_row_count, detail_row_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{createdBy}, #{exportMode}, #{taskIdsJson}, #{countryIso2sJson}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{snapshotAt}, #{attemptCount}, 0, #{detailRowCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_task_export_job WHERE export_mode = 'HYPERLINK_ACCOUNT_STATS' AND attempt_count < 3 AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now})) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE export_mode = 'HYPERLINK_ACCOUNT_STATS' AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now} AND attempt_count >= 3

UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status = 'SUCCESS', storage_key = #{storageKey}, file_name = #{fileName}, content_type = #{contentType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, detail_row_count = #{detailRowCount}, error_message = NULL, lease_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND export_mode = 'HYPERLINK_ACCOUNT_STATS' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_task_export_job WHERE export_mode = 'HYPERLINK_ACCOUNT_STATS' AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND expires_at <= #{now} AND storage_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expires_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
